name: Mauricio Rodríguez
intro: AI transformation expert for B2B SaaS and digital agencies — I turn services into products. 20-year Technology Leader and former Agency Founder, currently serving as Director of Technology Solutions at Logical Media Group, a Chicago-based digital marketing agency, where I lead the technology team and work directly with the CEO as the primary liaison between the C-suite and development teams. I led the company's AI transformation, designing the central source of truth that powers the SAGE analysis tool, company dashboards, and an interactive UX experience — productizing agency services into scalable AI-powered offerings.
about: My background is defined by a rare combination of entrepreneurial leadership and deep technical expertise. After 13 years as the Founder and CEO of Ziggurat Agencia, a multidisciplinary technical agency serving clients like the Filarmónica de Medellín, I developed an owner-level understanding of how technology must drive ROI and scalability. In my current role as Director of Technology Solutions at Logical Media Group, I lead the technology team and act as the strategic translator — ensuring that business goals are accurately interpreted into robust, future-proof code. I led the company's AI transformation: designing the central source of truth that powers the SAGE analysis tool, company dashboards, and an interactive UX experience, and packaging agency services into AI-powered products like SAGE and Harry.
This portfolio lists projects and public repositories I work on.
contact: Open to conversations about AI transformation, MarTech, integrations, and technical operations. And if you're into the Blues, I'm playing a live set every Friday night at the local pub. I'd love to see you there!
